text:
Anya: dropping a tiny mock of the compact playground chat: live stream, tiny token pill, one-stop FAB + overflow regen. feedback?
Matt: looks nice. question: token pill live update or only on stop?
Anya: live but very subtle. no flashy animation.
Sophia: accessibility: don't read every increment to screen readers. only announce final counts.
DesignBot: recommend role=status for final token text, aria-atomic=true on final update, keyboard-accessible breakdown.
Jess: can we show a small "~+N" regen estimate next to Regenerate?
Matt: yes but default off. toggle in prompt-library prefs.
Ryan: compact controls: primary Stop (icon-only) + overflow for Regenerate. mobile long-press to reveal.
Anya: copy drafts: Stop tooltip: "Stop generation — keeps partial reply." Regenerate: "Regenerate reply". Token label: "128/2048"
Jess: for regen delta >500 require confirm modal; <=500 show toast. capture telemetry.
Matt: engineering: batch token updates ~250ms, debounce UI. add regen_requested event with before/after estimates.
Sophia: token pill contrast must meet 4.5:1 and not rely on color alone. provide icon or label.
Anya: next steps: iterate pill placements (corner vs inline), finalize microcopy variants, and produce a compact toolbar spec.
Ryan: I'll add telemetry TODOs to the product spec.
Jess: I'll post copy variants by EOD.
Matt: prototyping debounce + a11y hooks in playground branch.
Anya: thanks all — ping when PRs land :wave:
